title: Drive Fusion failure-rate factors
note: Multipliers on a drive's base AFR (PLAN §8.2). Each is 1.0 when its input is unknown, so a missing fact never lowers a rate. Ranges are [from, to) with to = null meaning no upper bound. The values are Drive Fusion's own judgement, informed by the shape of published fleet statistics (infant mortality, a flat middle, wear-out from year 4); they are not measured and should be revised as data allows.
